en.bestFor: Lists of tips, tools, mistakes or reasons — "N things…" videos for Reels, Shorts, or carousels turned into video.
en.structure: Each clip runs 3–8 seconds: an opening hook, one clip per item, and an optional short outro. About 3 items for 15–20s, 4–5 for 30–45s and 6–8 for 50–60s; a micro version fits 1–2 items.
en.hook: States the count and the promise ("5 things…", "3 mistakes…") while the first number or item slams in, sometimes teasing the final item.
en.arc: Strong item first, weakest in the middle, best saved for last with the most vivid image. Long lists may switch camera or scale once mid-way to reset attention; the outro shows the whole set together and rests.
en.narrator: An energetic, clear host talking to the viewer, with every item line in the same parallel shape (e.g. "Number one: …" or "Want X? Do Y.").
en.visual: Look and palette come from the chosen visual style. Every frame shows a numbered list of the item titles, clearly readable, with the current one highlighted, plus a matching number badge and one concrete image per item in a constant setting.
en.audio: A driving beat that hits each time a number pops in and builds up on the final item.
en.rules: Items come only from your source — the list is never padded. Each item needs a concrete visual stand-in. The narration isn't captioned; the numbered list is the on-screen text.
